name: Spelling-Bee Brain
effect: Boosting this layer-12 neuron makes the model treat every question as a question about the words in it, and it answers with confident, wrong comments on letters, acronyms and what words "stand for".
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
